forward: +Z (models face +Z; walk clip moves along +Z before root-motion stripping)
notes: All avatar GLBs are already in metres and Y-up (FBX2glTF converted cm/Z-up). Use scale 1 and no rotation; the feet sit at y=0 at the model origin.
Files use EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization + EXT_texture_webp: call useGLTF(url, false, true) / GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder).
Clone each avatar with SkeletonUtils.clone() (three/examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js) before reusing it; plain .clone() breaks skinning.

Animation GLBs contain only the Bip01 skeleton + clips; bind with new AnimationMixer(avatarRoot) and mixer.clipAction(clip). Track names match avatar node names exactly (GLTFLoader turns spaces into underscores on both sides, e.g. Bip01_Pelvis).

Sit clips: Bip01 (pelvis) is at ~0.61 m (female) / ~0.58 m (male) above the origin; place the model origin on the floor at the chair centre, chair seat height ~0.45-0.48 m, table top ~0.75 m with its near edge ~0.25-0.30 m in front (+Z) of the origin.
walk is in place (Bip01 horizontal translation removed). Original root speed: female 1.21 m/s, male 1.01 m/s; move the object at that speed along its local +Z to avoid foot sliding.

Materials (v2): '<code>_skin_head' = face/neck skin + painted hair cap (2048px colour + normal, 1024px metallicRoughness map); '<code>_body' = clothing + hands (1024px colour/normal/metallicRoughness). Roughness comes from the source specular maps (skin ~0.38-0.85, cloth ~0.45-0.88), metalness 0. Needs an environment map (scene.environment, e.g. drei <Environment>) for the skin sheen to read.

Hair/eyelashes are drawn twice from the same geometry: '<code>_hair_core' (alphaMode MASK, cutoff 0.5, double-sided, writes depth) plus '<code>_hair_fringe' (BLEND, double-sided, depthWrite false) for soft edges. Do not override these to opaque; if you traverse materials, leave alphaTest/transparent as loaded. guest_f2 also has '<code>_glasses' (BLEND).

Skin material names: f014_skin_head, f015_skin_head, f020_skin_head, m008_skin_head, m015_skin_head, m016_skin_head, m025_skin_head, f011_skin_head, f019_skin_head, f018_skin_head, m004_skin_head, m013_skin_head (match with name.endsWith('_skin_head')).
